title: Second machine. Burn out 1yr
text:
Second machine. Burn out 1yr. Keep the machine clean. Used for a thousand square feet as needed. Certainly not enough to burn out. Loved the old hoover vacuum from childhood, but they don't make them like they used to i guess.. :/

Update 2nd machine just fried after 1 yr.... i'm Done hoover.

product_metadata.title: Hoover PowerDash Pet+ Compact Carpet Cleaner, Lightweight, FH50751, White
features: THE MOST POWERFUL COMPACT CARPET WASHER: The most powerful compact carpet cleaner
POWERFUL SCRUBBING AND SUCTION: Power through tough pet messes with PowerSpin brushes and strong suction for deep cleaning
HEATFORCE FASTER DRYING: HeatForce Technology dries as you clean and gets you back to your carpets faster
COMPACT CONVENIENCE: Compact, lighweight design makes it easy to grab & go and tackle everything from everyday messes to high traffic areas
PET PERFORMANCE: Perfect for pets, the PowerSpin Pet Brush Roll and included Paws & Claws cleaning formula work together to loosen and lift pet stains
LARGER TANK, FEWER FILL-UPS: Go further and stop less to fill up with a new, larger clean water tank
BONUS STORAGE MAT: Bonus storage mat helps protect your floors and keep dirty water off clean surfaces after use
description: The new & improved Hoover PowerDash Pet is a powerful, compact carpet washer designed for convenient and effortless cleaning anywhere in your home. The lightweight, grab & go portability makes cleaning from room to room easy while the stronger suction helps you target deep embedded stains. Our Heatforce Technology also assists with dry time so you can get back on your carpets faster. With even greater efficiency and powerful cleaning performance, the Powerdash Pet+ is perfect for tackling any pet mess with ease.
